entities.title: human-assisted-software-development
entities.summary: HASD: a methodology for software development in which AI drives and humans guide, kept as the agent skills and knowledge catalogue other repositories copy.
entities.purpose: The repository root holds the methodology's agent-facing part in Agents/ (the skills, with their view schemas and validate_diagrams.py, and the knowledge catalogue, with its schemas and validate_knowledge.py), the actors its own .dev files name in Actors/, and AGENTS.md, the instructions for agents working here.
boundaries: This repository is the original of Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge. Other repositories copy them to Meta/Agents/Skills and Meta/Agents/Knowledge, and a change is made here and copied there; this repository holds no Meta/Agents copy of itself.
Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge hold no .dev folder of their own, because they are copied whole; what is recorded about them is in Agents/.dev until the open decision there is taken.
The Cyberspace explorer, which shows a repository's .dev folders, lives in its own repository, cyberspace-explorer; nothing here builds or deploys it.
